ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_text.role: context-menu item that copies the pointed transcript line as plain text
ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_text.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_text.note: Plain text means the visible words: markdown fences, list markers and emphasis are stripped. It must read as different from the Markdown item beside it.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_markdo.role: context-menu item that copies the pointed transcript line's original Markdown source
ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_markdo.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_markdo.note: This keeps fences, lists, headings and links. The distinction from Copy text is the point of offering both.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_select.role: context-menu item that copies the reader's current text highlight
ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_select.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_select.note: Disabled when there is no highlight. Its accessible name is also used by the selection toolbar's Copy button.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.toast.copied_mar.role: success toast after Copy as Markdown writes the clipboard
ui.chat.transcript_copy.toast.copied_mar.tone: short confirmation, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.transcript_copy.toast.copied_mar.note: Names the form that was copied so the reader can tell the two copy actions apart.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.toast.copied_sel.role: success toast after Copy selection writes the clipboard
ui.chat.transcript_copy.toast.copied_sel.tone: short confirmation, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.transcript_copy.toast.copied_sel.note: Confirms the highlight, not the whole row, was copied.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.row.your_message.role: accessible name of a focusable user message row in the transcript
ui.chat.transcript_copy.row.your_message.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.transcript_copy.row.your_message.note: Screen-reader only. The row is a group and the read message follows; this names whose message it is.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.row.agent_messag.role: accessible name of a focusable assistant message row in the transcript
ui.chat.transcript_copy.row.agent_messag.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.transcript_copy.row.agent_messag.note: Screen-reader only. Must differ from the user row's name so a turn's two sides are distinguishable.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.selection.copy.role: accessible name of the Copy button on the floating selection toolbar
ui.chat.transcript_copy.selection.copy.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.transcript_copy.selection.copy.note: Acts on the highlight, not the whole message. Keep it distinct from the row's own Copy control.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.selection.toolba.role: accessible name of the floating toolbar that appears when the reader highlights transcript text, naming the group rather than any one action
ui.chat.transcript_copy.selection.toolba.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.transcript_copy.selection.toolba.note: Screen-reader only: it labels the group that holds the selection's actions (Quote, Copy). Do not name a single action here, or the group and its button announce the same thing.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.block.logs.note: Above a tool's log output; the output itself is not translated.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.selection.quote.note: Adds the selected text to the composer as a quotation.

ui.chat.transcript_copy.technical_detail.note: Opens the transcript's technical blocks (logs, raw output).
